overview_description.description:
HappiLabs, LLC was established in Chicago in 2013. They are a purchasing organization that provides virtual lab manager services with a speciality of shopping for scientific lab supplies, chemicals/reagents, and equipment (think...personal shopper for scientists).


They noticed that scientists do not have resources available to make informed purchasing decisions about lab supplies and all the companies who sell them.

about_short_description.short_description: HappiLabs provides a variety of services to help scientists and biotech labs be better with finance and lab operations.

product.name: Virtual Lab Manager
product.description: A service that manages lab purchasing, logistics, accounting, and EH&S paperwork for scientists.

product.name: Lab Purchasing
product.description: Service includes managing shopping lists, negotiating prices, and processing purchase orders for lab supplies.

product.name: Price Comparison & Product Sourcing
product.description: Service involves finding the right supplies and equipment through research and supplier outreach.

product.name: Supplier Relations
product.description: Managing relationships with suppliers, including account setup and customer service issues.

product.name: Logistics Coordination
product.description: Tracking shipments and coordinating delivery times for lab orders.

product.name: Finance Integration
product.description: Tracking lab spending through invoice and receipt management, and providing end-of-month reports.
